name: crm-with-reviews
description: TradePro CRM + ReviewFlow merged into one deployable system on a single Supabase project

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build:all -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run build -w client
